user.title: Add a GE Opal ice maker
user.description: Choose a nearby Opal ice maker found by Home Assistant Bluetooth, or enter its address manually.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add GE Opal ice maker
bluetooth_confirm.description: Home Assistant found {name} ({address}). Do you want to add it?

manual.title: Connect a GE Opal ice maker
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of your Opal ice maker. The device must be visible to a connectable Home Assistant Bluetooth adapter.

error.no_devices_found: No Opal ice makers were found in Bluetooth range. Make sure it is powered, not connected to another client (such as the phone app), and within range of a connectable adapter or proxy, then try again or enter the address below.
error.device_not_found: The device is not currently visible to Home Assistant Bluetooth. Move it closer or check the adapter/proxy.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this device is already in progress.
